Numerator:
\[
\cos5^\circ\cos20^\circ-\sin5^\circ\sin20^\circ=\cos25^\circ
\]
and
\[
\cos35^\circ\cos50^\circ-\sin35^\circ\sin50^\circ=\cos85^\circ.
\]
So
\[
N=\cos25^\circ+\cos85^\circ.
\]
Using sum-to-product,
\[
\cos25^\circ+\cos85^\circ=2\cos55^\circ\cos(-30^\circ)=\sqrt3\cos55^\circ.
\]

Denominator:
\[
\sin5^\circ\cos20^\circ+\cos5^\circ\sin20^\circ=\sin25^\circ
\]
and
\[
\sin35^\circ\cos50^\circ+\cos35^\circ\sin50^\circ=\sin85^\circ.
\]
So
\[
D=\sin25^\circ-\sin85^\circ.
\]
Using sum-to-product,
\[
\sin25^\circ-\sin85^\circ=2\cos55^\circ\sin(-30^\circ)=-\cos55^\circ.
\]

Therefore,
\[
\tan\theta=\frac{\sqrt3\cos55^\circ}{-\cos55^\circ}=-\sqrt3.
\]
The least positive angle with tangent \(-\sqrt3\) is
\[
\theta=120^\circ.
\]
